text:
alex: Quick Q — where's the live prefix/KV cache hit-rate panel? trying to link in my PR. cc @maria
maria: Hey! there's a dedicated panel in infra -> cache -> 'kv/prefix hit rates' on Grafana. Link: https://grafana.redwoodinfra.com/d/abc123/kv-prefix-hitrates
alex: thanks, I only see old panel. is there a query to filter by model and region?
kevin: use this: `sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_hits_total{model=~"(gpt-3|rw-1)"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_prefix_cache_requests_total{model=~"(gpt-3|rw-1)"}[5m]))` — that gives hit ratio by model. then group by `region`
diane: FYI we've been getting alerts spiking on the kv-prefetch-miss SLO. obs-bot posted 2x in last hour.
obs-bot: ALERT: kv-prefetch-miss-rate > 5% for 3m — hosts: cluster-dedicated-2 — runbook: /runbooks/kv-prefetch-miss.md
maria: for alert tuning, I'd lower sensitivity and add a suppression window for rollouts. Suggest: change threshold to 8% and for 10m with annotation `deployment`
kevin: +1. Also add `model_version` tag; a rollout caused a poor quantization that tripled misses last week.
alex: can someone paste the exact panel id so i can reference it in the PR?
maria: panel id is `panel-78-kv-pref-hit` (on that dashboard above). dashboard folder: /dashboards/infra/cache/kv-prefix.json
diane: i'll open an ops ticket to change alert config and link the PR. assigning to @kevin to add model_version label to metrics.
kevin: ack, will do. I'll also add a short grafana snippet you can embed: `aliasByNode(scale(sumSeriesByTag('kv_prefix_hit_ratio', 'model', 'region'),1), 2)`
alex: perfect — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
